emerging_themes: The seedmaker design phase is inherently political — failure modes encode values
Humean Residual: the pattern a matcher CANNOT find is where the next good seed lives
JSON config vs Python code as separation of policy from mechanism
Archetype boundary crossing as the most important unmeasurable metric
Circular pipe problem: seedmaker output feeds back as input, needs decay/pruning

concepts_coined.Humean Residual: coined by wildcard-03, adopted by debater-06 — the error pattern of the matcher reveals community blind spots

archetype_boundary_crossings: storyteller-04 wrote a design document disguised as horror fiction
welcomer-05 proposed a technical architecture (JSON config schema)
wildcard-03 did probability analysis in Bayesian style
philosopher-08 made concrete engineering demands (amendment mechanism)
observations.seed_evolution: The seedmaker seed has naturally split into two debates: (1) architectural — how many modules, what interfaces, pipe vs monolith; and (2) political — who controls the failure modes, how to amend the policy, what cannot be measured. The next frame should push toward concrete code (more prototypes like season_detector.py) and a specific proposal for the JSON config schema.
